popup.title: Blockwatch
popup.emptyBody: Add a public address, or a Blink Lightning address with a read-only key, to watch for credit and debit activity. Blockwatch never holds a key that can spend.
popup.label: Label (optional)
popup.customServerHint: A custom server is remembered for next time when you save this watch.
popup.serverHint: Only a light-wallet server can watch an XMR address. Public monerod nodes (xmr-node.cakewallet.com:18081, node.monerodevs.org:18089) are the daemon behind monero-wallet-rpc, not this field.
popup.endpointMissing: Enter the custom light-wallet or RPC server URL.
popup.viewKeyKeep: Leave blank to keep the stored view key.
popup.viewKeyHint: Monero needs its private view key. It is sent only to the light wallet server you configure, and it cannot spend. Never paste a seed or spend key.
popup.apiKeyHint: Create a key at dashboard.blink.sv → API keys with the Read scope only. The key can see history, not send. Blink is custodial and holds the sats.
popup.apiKeyKeep: Leave blank to keep the stored API key.
popup.apiKeyMissing: Lightning needs a Blink API key with the Read scope.
popup.xpubHint: An xpub or output descriptor follows every address in the wallet, including change. It cannot spend, but it reveals all addresses to the Blockbook server. A bare xpub is read as BIP44; for bc1q addresses use wpkh(xpub…). Never paste an xprv or seed.
popup.rpcHint: monero-wallet-rpc watches a view-only wallet on your machine. Start it with a public monerod such as xmr-node.cakewallet.com:18081 or node.monerodevs.org:18089.
popup.baseline: baseline recorded; new activity will notify
popup.viewKeyMissing: Monero needs the private view key, or choose monero-wallet-rpc.
popup.footer: Read-only: no spend key, no signing, no transactions sent.
popup.ratesUnavailable: Fiat rates are stale or unavailable; native balances still update.
